summary: 150 Wine is about 38 Winery batches (2 Fruit + 1 Bottle each). Bottles need Glass, and the only Glass source is the Evergreen Trading Outpost at 2 Wheat per pane, so plant about 80 Wheat tiles early. Grape Vines and the 24 Apple Trees cover the Fruit; Felix lowers Community, Fun and Wellness needs for the Happiness objective.

build_order.note: About 80 tiles as early as possible; 12-day crop.
6 Clay + 6 Bricks; 1 Glass + 1 Stick per Bottle.
13 days, then one fruit every 1.3 to 2 days.
Happiness: Plaza, Playground, Fitness Park, Zen Garden.

pitfalls: Wheat growth sets the pace; plant before anything optional.
Happiness is a main objective here; build social spots during the wait, not after.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
